# Eight-lesson allocation — Weeks11–12
Each lesson ~50–55 minutes with short retrieval and exit evidence. Work/assessment replaces existing time; no extra project deadline or new summative assessment.
Week 11 L1: 5 min retrieval, 15 min six-table keys/dependencies, 25 min A design repair, 5–10 min feedback. L2: 5 min predict, 15 min model one join, 25 min B queries, 5–10 min explain NULL/grain. L3: 5 min retrieval, 15 min C transactions/connectivity/recovery, 25 min test/evidence critique, 5–10 min exit. L4: 5 min Unit 3 retrieval, 15 min D/E/F stimulus and roles, 25 min explained case response, 5–10 min peer feedback.
Week 12 L1: fresh T1/T2 query/data transfer; predictions, independent SQL, explanation and review. L2: fresh T3/T4 modelling/privacy/security; evidence-based extended response and feedback. L3: original 24-mark controlled formative sample in the already allocated theory-test slot; if replacing school's planned summative theory task teacher must adapt/approve, not count both. L4: mark/diagnose, explain corrections, independent changed-data retry, prioritise Week 13–14 consolidation.
Model answers/reference scripts are openly downloadable within the public textbook and not protected as secure assessment materials. Use new teacher-controlled variants for any secure assessment. Samples aren't endorsed exams. Review symbols, scope, current law and assessment alignment; pack is not a full syllabus audit.
